items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (higher-output replacement, larger cooling capacity than the damaged one)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.9 and 7.1.10: Only a like-for-like replacement of the damaged 3.5 kW unit is indemnified; the upgrade to a 7.1 kW model is an improvement and not covered beyond the cost of an equivalent 3.5 kW unit. Reference Case 38 (similar fixed AC unit, surge loss, t between 1352 and 1445 for a like-for-like replacement).
Policy 7.1.9: Installation of a like-for-like replacement is covered. Reference Case 38 (installation for living-room AC unit, t between 468 and 488).

items.description: Decorative floor console (chosen for room appearance, not required by the new unit)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.10 and 3.5(d): Not indemnified, as this is an improvement for appearance only and not required for the function or installation of the replacement unit. Reference Case 38 (console for appearance, t between 54 and 67, but only covered if required for installation; here, it is not).
Policy 7.1.9(e) and 7.1.12: Ordinary freight for the covered replacement is indemnified. Reference Case 38 (freight shipping, t between 40 and 43).
Policy 7.1.12: Surcharges for expedited/timed delivery are not indemnified unless agreed in advance or necessary to avert further loss, which is not indicated here.
Policy 7.1.8(b): General administrative/handling/processing charges are not indemnified, regardless of how they are described.
